title: Postman or Insomnia: Choosing an API Client
excerpt: Two popular tools for building and testing APIs. Postman has grown into a full API platform; Insomnia stays lighter and more focused.
verdict: Postman is the more complete option for larger teams that need automated testing, monitoring, documentation and shared workspaces. Insomnia suits individual developers and small teams who want a fast, lightweight client without the extra complexity.
